title: Pregnant mum won £1m lottery, then welcomed her baby four days later
summary_full: In February 2019, Natalie and Andrew Symes unexpectedly won £1 million in the EuroMillions lottery. Shortly after their win, they welcomed their daughter Poppy a month earlier than expected. The couple used their winnings to buy a home and relieve financial pressure during lockdowns. Natalie's ability to stay home with the children has been a significant change in their lives.
